content: SheetJS official docs (fetched 2026-08-06): npm registry xlsx is STALE (0.18.5); authoritative source is https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz (install via tarball URL; vendoring recommended). React Native: XLSX.writeFile does NOT work out of the box in RN/Expo; the documented pattern is XLSX.write(wb, {type:'base64', bookType:'xlsx'}) then expo-file-system writeAsStringAsync(uri, b64, {encoding: base64}); reads via readAsStringAsync(base64) + XLSX.read(b64, {type:'base64'}). Demo warns 'Unsupported scheme for location' when expo-file-system receives URIs it can't read (e.g. content:// from pickers — must copyToCacheDirectory first). UTF-8 + peso sign fine in modern xlsx; cpexcel codepage module only needed for legacy formats. Snyk prototype-pollution report is a tooling false positive (fixed in 0.19.3) — use current CDN version.
